meta.author: Rev2D examples
meta.description: Live2D-style anime bust (vector only). Head turn via a 3x3 AngleX x AngleY warp keyform grid, eye/mouth path morphs, iris masks, hair physics. L/R suffixes = character left/right (L is on screen right).

parameters.description: Head turn: + looks toward screen right.
Head tilt: + rotates clockwise (1/3 degree per unit).
Character's left eye (screen right): 0 closed, 1 open.
Character's right eye (screen left): 0 closed, 1 open.

bones.description: Hips -> shoulders. Rotated -90 so the bone points up; BodyAngleX leans it.
Pivot under the chin; AngleZ rotates it.

warps.description: Back hair: HairBack sway, moves opposite to the face on head turns (parallax).
Head turn: AngleX x AngleY keyform grid. Parent of all face parts and front hair.
Moves both irises with EyeBallX / EyeBallY.
Bangs: HairFront sway (bottom row swings most).
Right side lock (screen left): HairSide sway.
Left side lock (screen right): HairSide sway.

parts.description: Hair behind the head and shoulders.
Strand lines on the back hair (stroke only), clipped to it.
Shadow the chin casts on the neck; follows the head, clipped to the neck.
Soft shadow the collar casts on the blouse.
Eye white. Its shape morphs closed with the Eye*Open parameter and masks the iris.
Upper lid line; morphs into the closed-eye line.
Eye white. Its shape morphs closed with the Eye*Open parameter and masks the iris.
Upper lid line; morphs into the closed-eye line.
Mouth interior; MouthOpen x MouthForm path keyforms.
Strand line (open path: stroke only), clipped to the lock.
Strand line (open path: stroke only), clipped to the lock.
Strand separation lines (open paths: stroke only), clipped to the bangs.
Angel-ring highlight: lens shapes along an arc, clipped to the bangs.
Shadow of the bangs on the forehead (the bangs outline shifted down, clipped to the face).

bindings.description: Pseudo-3D head turn: the face center shifts most, the silhouette least (far side compresses).
Closed keyform: the lids meet; the eye white shrinks to a sliver under the lash, hiding everything it masks.
Closed keyform: the lids meet; the eye white shrinks to a sliver under the lash, hiding everything it masks.
2D path keyforms: every keyform uses the same commands (M C C Z), so numbers interpolate.

physics.description: Short, springy pendulum for the bangs.
Two-segment chain for the side locks (output: last segment).
Long, slow chain for the back hair.

animations.description: Breathing with a gentle body/head sway and one blink per loop; loops seamlessly. The sways use ease "smooth" (Catmull-Rom through the keys, closed over the loop), so they flow through every key instead of stopping at it.

One blink (one-shot, starts at t=0): lids meet at t=0.08s, reopen by 0.32s. Starts and ends open (the default), so it layers with once: idle + "blink,once,start=1.5" adds a blink and hands the eyes back.

One-shot wink designed for layering with once: the left eye (screen right) shuts, the other squints, a smile and blush come and go. Every track starts and ends at its parameter default, so idle + "wink,once,start=1" hands the face back seamlessly (over a talk layer, which also drives the mouth, use "wink,add,once,start=1").

Cheerful talking designed for mode "add": mouth flaps with a smile, small nods and raised brows, every head track centered on the parameter default (0), so look_around + "talk,add" keeps the head motion and adds the nods. 2 s divides the 4 s idle and the 6 s look_around, so layered loops close.
A friendly nod: head dips, rebounds, settles; eyes squint and she smiles.
Eyes lead, head follows: looks left, right and back; blinks while turning. Hair physics swings.
